sources.entry: Prowlarr | An indexer manager/proxy built on *Arr to integrate with various media software like Sonarr, Radarr, and Lidarr. Supports multiple indexers and automation.

summary.one_liner: Prowlarr is an indexer manager and proxy built on the *Arr .NET/ReactJS stack that centralizes torrent tracker and Usenet indexer management for Lidarr, Mylar3, Radarr, Readarr, and Sonarr.
summary.what_it_does: Prowlarr manages both Torrent trackers and Usenet indexers from one place, so indexers do not need to be configured separately in each PVR app. It syncs indexers to Lidarr, Mylar3, Radarr, Readarr, and Sonarr automatically. It supports native Usenet indexers (24 listed) plus any Newznab-compatible indexer, and over 500 native torrent trackers plus any Torznab-compatible tracker. Custom indexer definitions can be written in YML via Cardigann, including JSON and XML parsing. It also offers indexer history and statistics, manual category-level and parameter-based searches, and bulk pushing of releases to download clients. Per-indexer proxy support covers SOCKS4, SOCKS5, HTTP, and Flaresolverr, and indexer health notifications are included.
use_cases: Centralize torrent tracker and Usenet indexer setup for Sonarr and Radarr
Sync indexers automatically to Lidarr, Readarr, or Mylar3
Add custom indexers via YML Cardigann definitions
Route indexer traffic through a SOCKS or HTTP proxy
Manually search indexers by category across trackers
Monitor indexer health and search history
notable: Syncs indexer configuration to Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, Readarr, and Mylar3 so no per-app indexer setup is needed
Supports over 500 torrent trackers and 24 native Usenet indexers, plus generic Newznab and Torznab
Custom indexer definitions in YML via Cardigann, including JSON and XML parsing
Per-indexer proxy support including SOCKS4, SOCKS5, HTTP, and Flaresolverr
caveats: GitHub Issues are reserved for bugs and feature requests only; support is handled elsewhere
README gives no installation or run instructions
